title: Watersound Crossings C-102 - 100 S Bridge Lane
h1: Watersound Crossings C-102 - 100 S Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Gulf Front - Convenient Beach Access - Lake Views- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout.*This property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: If you're looking for convenient beach living, this home is perfect for you. The backdoor is situation directly beside the Watersound beach access! The primary bedroom is conveniently located on the first floor of this incredible condo. This bedroom includes a plush king bed, additional sofa, a private porch and a spacious bathroom with a tub, shower, a double vanity and two closets!Just up the stairs, you will find an open concept living area boasting Gulf and Dune views. This living room is adjacent to the gourmet kitchen and farmhouse dining room table. Just off this dining room you'll find beautiful french doors that lead you out to the sprawling porch where you can enjoy your morning coffee or dinner al fresco! The second floor also includes two guest bedrooms. The first bedroom features two twin beds and a private bathroom with a stand up shower. The second guest bedroom includes a king bed and private bathroom with another beautiful stand up shower. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With ShowerGuest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower * Unfortunately due to HOA rules the guest will not be able to rent Low-Speed Vehicles and will not be able to bring their own Low-Speed Vehicle.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
